chat:4:Which schemes am I eligible for?.reply:
Here is what you can apply for:
• MUDRA — eligible: Collateral-free loans for non-farm income-generating micro enterprises — Shishu up to ₹50,000, Kishore ₹50,001–₹5 lakh, Tarun ₹5–10 lakh, Tarun Plus ₹10–20 lakh.
• KCC (Dairy) — eligible: Working-capital credit for dairy / animal-husbandry units; collateral-free up to ₹2 lakh.
• CGTMSE — likely: Lender gets a credit guarantee so it can lend to MSEs WITHOUT collateral or third-party guarantee (cover up to ₹10 crore per borrower).
• PM Vishwakarma — likely: For traditional artisans in 18 trades (e.g. tailor, blacksmith, carpenter): collateral-free credit ₹1 lakh then ₹2 lakh at 5%, toolkit e-voucher, skilling with stipend.
Each rule is cited — tap a scheme for the clause.

Helping you: Existing EMI / moneylender repayments vs income, Operating surplus (inflow minus outflow), Share of days with sales. chat:4:What documents do I need?.reply: You need 9 documents (not ~18). Upload: Passport photo, Business address / existence proof, Quotation for machinery / stock, Cattle-shed / land proof, Livestock details. I can fetch with your consent: PAN card, Udyam Registration certificate.

chat:4:How much will I save vs the money.reply: I don't see moneylender repayments in your UPI data. A scheme loan at ~9–12% is far cheaper than 24–36% informal credit.

chat:4:Who can see my data?.reply: Your data is encrypted with a key unique to you (AES-256-GCM). Nobody — not a bank, agent or scheme office — can see it without a consent you grant for a specific purpose and time, and you can revoke it anytime from the Consent Vault. Every access is logged and visible to you. 'Erase my data' destroys your key.

chat:4:What does the agent charge?.reply: ARTHA does the agent's job — finding schemes, assembling documents, following up — for free. Agents typically charge 10–15% of the loan; on ₹3 lakh that is ₹30,000–45,000 you keep.
